title: Current missing work and conformance gates
summary: Do not call renderer parity complete until real adapters for Web, Swing, GTK/Direct Linux and Android emit the canonical conformance transcript. Record package metadata debt and evidence gaps explicitly.

items.work: Bind the current Web runtime to the v0.2 conformance fixture and produce a real normalized transcript.
Bind Swing dev11 (semantic baseline dev10) to the v0.2 fixture; prove RangeRequested, event-time workspaceContext and resource/deauthorisation semantics.
Bind Direct Linux/GTK dev38 to the v0.2 fixture. Preserve stable identity and RangeRequested source-ownership boundary.
Recover/advance an Android renderer adapter from the documented dev7 semantic checkpoint; keep native host dev16 separate from renderer-version authority.
Repair Direct Linux archive metadata in its owning package: archive/QUALIFICATION say dev38, VERSION says dev37 and README header is older. Do not repair provenance in this sphere.
Make all renderers consume exact Resource Editor/contract publications and fail closed for missing required resource authority; no generated customer copy.
Expose/readiness-stage evidence so transport connection is not conflated with synchronized semantic view.

Local Queue Fabric admission journal/idempotency/replay qualified in Candidate3. Still OPEN: signed .wapp verifier, Storage Fabric fetch, host writer lease, power-loss recovery and public TLS/WSS integration.
Qualify real TLS/HTTPS/WebSocket browser traffic, access control and restart recovery across two apps.
Qualify retained application generation drain and stale semantic revisions under concurrent upgrades.

Locally qualified on 2026-10-27 (Candidate3 8/8 ooRexx tests, 7/7 rexxc): durable requestId admission and replay. Next integrate single-active-writer host fencing and job resumption; local journal test is not production proof.
Prove QueueDurableStore fsync/power-loss safety and cross-host single-writer fencing under failover before marking deployment journal production durable.

Implement explicit Intentions producer translation from the early wire.application.deploy/0.1 candidate to the strict wire.deployment.command/0.1 five-field ingress; no silent aliasing; enforce signer and target policy.
